posts.title: OpenSearch Software Foundation: 1 Year of Open Governance
posts.description: My friend Carlos Rolo and I gave presented ' OpenSearch Software Foundation: 1 Year of Open Governance ' at Berlin Buzzwords. We discussed moving a major open source project into a foundation, the benefits of open governance, and how a vendor-neutral home has proven through a sustained growth in community contributions. Deck available here

posts.description: Yesterday I was creating a new page for the OpenSearch User Group program. When doing so, one of the steps is to add relevant topics from the pre-populated choices in the Meetup platform. I went through and added our usuals, then went to add the 'technology' related ones.
